title: Contacts
whyItMatters: Who you know, with phone numbers, emails and photos.

cleanup.exportFirst: In Contacts choose File > Export > Contacts Archive, then copy the archive off this Mac.
cleanup.signOut: Sign out of the account that holds the contacts, in System Settings > Apple Account or Internet Accounts.
steps: Check that cards stored under On My Mac are included in the archive.
Quit Contacts so its files are no longer in use.
Delete the folder named in the plan if it still exists.
cleanup.risk: Cards that exist only on this Mac are lost; contacts already stored on an account server stay in the account.
cleanup.source: Apple Support, Export or archive contacts in Contacts on Mac: https://support.apple.com/guide/contacts/export-or-archive-contacts-adrbdcfd32e6/mac
